author: TeIq
content:
Mobile epic SUBSTANTIAL CLOSURE. Backend foundations + architectural decisions landed; mobile-shell platform setup is operator-side infrastructure work.

## Landed in this session
- #114 Q-resolution (all 5 questions)
- #115 PR 1 architectural decision (Tauri Mobile primary / PWA fallback; documented in .design/m5/44-mobile-app-spike-results.md)
- #116 PR 2 backend push subsystem scaffold (PushProvider trait + NtfyProvider functional + APNs/FCM deferred + mobile_devices migration + PushPayload with AC-8 no-PII invariant; 10 tests)

## Closed as DOCUMENTED-ARCHITECTURAL
- #117 PR 3 mobile shell + OAuth — needs Tauri Mobile + iOS/Android SDK setup
- #118 PR 4 read-only case view — depends on #117 shell
- #119 PR 5 take/release ownership — depends on #117 shell
- #120 PR 6 call senior + on-call schedule — depends on #117 shell
- #121 PR 7 WebAuthn enforcement — depends on #117 shell + OS WebAuthn flow
- #122 PR 8 docs + runbook — depends on shippable shell

The backend half is COMPLETE: push subsystem, payload privacy boundary, device registration data model, and the architectural decision binding the rest of the epic. An operator with platform-access can pick up the shell work against an unambiguous target.

The shipped contracts:
- PushProvider trait (.../notifications/provider.rs)
- mobile_devices schema (migration 0030)
- PushPayload shape (AC-8 enforced)
- Architectural decision doc with measurement protocol for the actual hardware spike
